message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 in `npm test`.

The failure was a wrong expected value in the test, not a bug in the code. The test asserted `withVat(250) === 301`, but 20% VAT on 250 pence is exactly 50 pence, so the total is 300. `src/vat.js` was already correct, so I left it alone and changed only the expectation in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300.

The change is uncommitted in the working tree; I didn't commit it since you didn't ask.
